transcript: Pass a glass of water over these three points of your body before bed and let it absorb all the negative energy you carry. Tomorrow, when you wake up, look at the water and you will understand why. This is one of the oldest cleansing practices that exist. Simple, silent and incredibly powerful. Take a clear glass and fill it with clean water. Hold it with both hands. Close your eyes and say quietly, absorb everything I carry that does not belong to me. You are giving it an order. You are telling the water what it needs to do for you. Now pass the glass slowly over your forehead without touching the skin just a few inches away. The forehead is where all the mental weight builds up, the decisions you never make, the worries that never stop. Then pass it over your chest. The chest holds everything you feel but never express. The sadness you swallow, the anxiety you pretend does not exist. And finally, pass it over your belly in slow circles. The belly is where the body stores fear, nerves, everything that churns inside of you. While you do this, repeat quietly, everything that is not mine stays in this water. Everything I absorb today, I release here. When you finish, place the glass on your nightstand and sleep. The water keeps working while you rest. In the morning, look at the glass. If it has bubbles, as if it had been boiling, there was a heavy load around you. If it is cloudy, the weight was even greater, weeks or months of accumulated energy. If it is clean and clear, your space is light. Never drink it. Pour it down the drain and wash the glass. And do not be afraid of what you find. Be afraid of how long you have been carrying all of that without doing anything about it. Not all exhaustion comes from the body. Sometimes what keeps you from resting is what you have been carrying without knowing it. Write in the comments, I cleanse. If you are going to do this tonight and come back tomorrow to tell me what you found, and if you feel that it is not just a cleansing you need, but that you need to learn how to release everything you carry inside. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that, and everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
